report.explanation: Alert observations show all checkout requests returning 200 with durations 78-344ms; traces show successful spans across order, inventory, payment, postgres and redis with no error status. Gateway p95 for /v1/checkout is ~437ms, modest and not clearly anomalous, and 502 count is zero. No evidence establishes a bounded root cause among the taxonomy; healthy telemetry contradicts fault hypotheses, so hand off for human review.
missing_evidence: Gateway logs (ev-...-gw-logs) were excluded; needed to see error/warn entries and confirm whether any fault occurred.
No dependency-operation metrics for gateway (empty series); cannot attribute latency to a downstream dependency.
No per-service latency breakdown for order/inventory/payment/postgres/redis to localize the slow span.
No deployment or config-change records to correlate with observed latency.
